# quay_organization_team_member (Resource)

Manages a single Quay team membership without owning the team or its other members. Use this resource for shared teams; use `quay_organization_team` to manage the full membership list of a team.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "quay_organization" "main" {
  name  = "main"
  email = "quay+main@example.com"
}

resource "quay_organization_team" "creators" {
  name    = "creators"
  orgname = quay_organization.main.name
  role    = "creator"

  # quay_organization_team_member manages members outside this resource, so ignore them here.
  # Without this, Terraform plans to remove the members that quay_organization_team_member added.
  lifecycle {
    ignore_changes = [members]
  }
}

resource "quay_organization_robot" "push" {
  name    = "push"
  orgname = quay_organization.main.name
}

# Add a single robot to the team without managing the team's other members.
resource "quay_organization_team_member" "test" {
  orgname    = quay_organization.main.name
  teamname   = quay_organization_team.creators.name
  membername = quay_organization_robot.push.fullname
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `membername` (String) Name of the user or robot (full name, e.g. `org+robot`) to add to the team
- `orgname` (String) Organization name
- `teamname` (String) Team name

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Membership ID in the format `orgname/teamname/membername`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# A team member can be imported using the organization name, team name and member name.
terraform import quay_organization_team_member.test main/creators/main+push
```
